timing.note: Exit waits for logo and both text entrances; text has 0.1s margin

implementation.logo: Original five SVG paths; native layer order and target opacity preserved
implementation.opacity: Logo linear fade over 0.24s (fade-only uses response); text fade q, rise/reveal min(2q,1), letters/spacing min(3q,1)
implementation.reducedMotion: No translation, scale, rotation or per-letter stagger; logo/wordmark 0.18s fade, slogan 0.18s fade after 0.08s
implementation.nativeReadiness: Do not delay a ready home screen to force the full prototype duration
implementation.punctuation: Splash only: remove terminal full stop in all languages; retain canonical slogan on other surfaces
implementation.webRuntime: Finite paused WAAPI animations; external player seeks currentTime
